are_you_ok.title: Heavy rain forecast raises flash flood risks in Colorado through weekend
are_you_ok.summary: Colorado faces a risk of flash flooding with storms likely on Friday and Saturday, especially over burn scars — hillsides stripped by past wildfires, where rain runs off instead of soaking in. Stay alert and avoid flooded roads.
questions: Are you near any of the burn scars they're worried about?
Does the flood risk change your plans for the weekend?
are_you_ok.description: Colorado faces a risk of flash flooding with storms likely on Friday and Saturday, especially in burn scar areas. Stay alert and avoid flooded roads.

you_should_know.title: Colorado minimum wage will jump in 2027 to $15.71/hour, $12.69 tipped
you_should_know.summary: According to the DLSS — Colorado's state labor standards division — the new wage of $15.71 represents a 3.6% increase over the current wage and a 41.5% increase from the wage in 2019 of $11.10 an hour.

you_should_know.title: Boulder delays license plate reader decision as scrutiny of Flock intensifies
you_should_know.summary: A Flock camera on U.S. 36 in Boulder, the highway linking Boulder to Denver. Credit: Brooke Stephenson After facing privacy concerns, Boulder invited companies to compete for its license plate reader contract and planned to choose a vendor by September. The city now says the process will take longer.

you_should_know.title: Universal Preschool providers face weeks-long waits for help after state downsizes support staff
you_should_know.summary: Support for UPK — Colorado's universal preschool program, which pays for part of every 4-year-old's preschool — went from 32 local organizations to a help desk with three state staffers, leaving preschool providers hanging ahead of the school year.

you_should_know.title: Report at center of lawsuit against Colorado Secretary of State Griswold may have been destroyed
you_should_know.summary: Former employees told CBS Colorado that Colorado Secretary of State Jena Griswold refused to take custody of the consultant's report because it was highly critical of her and she didn't want it subject to open records requests.
